data.text: 🚨 BREAKING: Kolkata is gearing up for Durga Puja 2026! With over 400 additional puja celebrations reported, police are strengthening security and crowd management across the city. 🥁🙏 #WestBengal #Kolkata #DurgaPuja2026

Ek sawal jo kal raat se dimag se nikal nahi raha...

​Durga Puja pandal ke bahar har koi khush tha.

Lights, music aur festive vibes.
​Par crowd ke kone mein ye chhoti si bachhi thi...

Haath mein colorful balloons liye par aankhon mein thakan.

​Jahan bache naye kapdo mein balloons maang rahe the

wahan ye raat ke 12 baje unhe bech kar pet bharne ki koshish kar rahi thi.

​Hum aksar choti-choti baaton par complain karte hain

par asli struggle kya hota hai, ye kal raat samajh aaya.

​Agar aap iski jagah hote, toh kya karte??

Strengthening Coordination for Safe & Peaceful Festivities

Dwarka District Police convened a meeting with Ramleela and Durga Puja organisers to discuss security arrangements, public safety, crowd management and smooth conduct of the upcoming festive celebrations. The interaction emphasised close coordination between the police and organisers to ensure a peaceful, safe and harmonious festive environment for all.

Dwarka District Police — Committed to Your Safety, Dedicated to Peace.
